project.title: Surface and drainage water metagenomics Raw sequence reads
project.description: Metagenomics analysis plays a crucial role in the assessment of water quality in the River Nile and drainage water in Egypt. By delving into the genetic material of microorganisms present in these water bodies, metagenomics provides a comprehensive understanding of the microbial communities and their impact on water quality. This approach enables the identification of pathogenic bacteria, viruses, and other harmful microorganisms, which could pose significant risks to human and environmental health. Additionally, metagenomics analysis offers insights into the presence of antibiotic resistance genes and pollutants, shedding light on potential environmental and public health concerns. Furthermore, it provides valuable data for the development of targeted strategies for water treatment and pollution control, ultimately contributing to the preservation of the River Nile and the surrounding water sources in Egypt.
